services.name: Indonesian Silat Class
services.desc: Spirit of the Heart believes everyone deserves the opportunity to learn and grow in the martial arts, regardless of financial circumstances. We’re committed to making our classes accessible to all. so if you are facing financial challenges. please reach out and we’ll work with you to find a solution that allows you to join us and begin your martial arts journey. Silat is well known for being a very “raw” martial art, with dynamic strikes, and movements that are designed to get right to the point! services.name: Open Sparring
services.desc: provides a safe, non-competitive way to challenge ourselves against other martial artists and get to know each other better. Students and teachers from many styles and many schools join together in friendship to learn from each other and have a great time! Open Sparring is a very uncommon event in which people from different schools and styles come together to train. Originally conceived as an almost anti-tournament, "Open Sparring" was designed with the goal of providing a space for participants to learn without the ego commonly found in the tournament scene.
